label: Land use overview by NUTS 2 region

label.HENVI: Land use with heavy environmental impact
label.U310: Transport, telecommunication, energy distribution, storage, protective works
label.U340: Commercial, financial, professional and information services

extension.description:
Land use statistics describe the area covered by the different land use classes recorded in the LUCAS survey. In this context, land use refers to the socio-economic function of the observed land surface. It includes uses such as agriculture, forestry, fishing, mining and quarrying, energy production, manufacturing, transport infrastructure, construction, services, residential use, nature protection areas, and unused or abandoned land.

The data are available for the LUCAS survey years 2009, 2012, 2015, 2018 and 2022. The indicators are expressed in square kilometres (km²) and as a percentage of the total area of each NUTS 2 region. A coefficient of variation is also provided as an indicator of the sampling uncertainty of the estimates.
